title: Backdoor Purification for LoRA-Tuned LLMs via Null-Space Projection
abstract: arXiv:2610.00685v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: With the rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, the risk of backdoor attacks has become more severe. Existing backdoor purification methods typically rely on at least one of the strong assumptions, such as prior knowledge of triggers, access to clean references, or aggressive retraining, and they often lack comprehensive evaluations. These constraints substantially limit their practical applicability. To overcome these challenges, our work proposes purifying LoRA-tuned LLMs without these assumptions and even without post-hoc retraining of the suspect parameters. Our objective is to significantly reduce the attack success rates (ASR) while preserving both (i) the base model's general capabilities and (ii) the new downstream skills learned through the adapter. Through a series of ablation studies, we progressively scale our approach from a single layer in a text classification set

translated_title: 通过零空间投影对LoRA微调的大语言模型进行后门净化
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）和参数高效微调（PEFT）方法的快速普及，后门攻击的风险变得更加严重。现有的后门净化方法通常至少依赖于以下强假设之一：对触发器的先验知识、对干净参考样本的访问权限，或进行激进的重新训练，而且这些方法往往缺乏全面的评估。这些限制极大地限制了它们的实际适用性。为了克服这些挑战，我们的工作提出了一种在不依赖这些假设、甚至无需对可疑参数进行事后重新训练的情况下净化LoRA微调LLM的方法。我们的目标是在显著降低攻击成功率（ASR）的同时，既保留基础模型的通用能力，又保留通过适配器学习到的新下游技能。通过一系列消融实验，我们将该方法从文本分类任务中的单层逐步扩展（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种基于零空间投影的后门净化方法，无需触发器先验知识、干净参考样本或重新训练，即可净化遭受后门攻击的LoRA微调大语言模型，在降低攻击成功率的同时保留模型的通用能力与下游技能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a null-space projection-based backdoor purification method for LoRA-tuned LLMs that removes backdoors without requiring trigger knowledge, clean references, or retraining, while preserving both the base model's general capabilities and downstream skills.
